name: Kaze no Satsui -It's a Long Way Round-
original_name: 風の殺意- It's a long way round -
source:
Six members of the broadcasting club gather at a villa in the mountains for a farewell party for former club director Haruki who leaves for the USA. Main character Kazuya secretly has romantic feelings for the members of the club. He organizes this this farewell party with quite a few surprises.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
广播部六名成员齐聚山中别墅，为即将前往美国的前部长Haruki举办欢送会。主人公Kazuya暗中对社团成员怀有恋爱情愫，并为这场欢送会准备了不少惊喜。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
